entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Scripture calls us to practise what we learn. Consider a question requiring wisdom in the light of practising the Scriptures. Resist a careless word; share hope without pressuring others.
entries.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a question requiring wisdom; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A renewed heart seeks the Lord in sincerity. Consider a moment of disappointment in the light of renewed devotion. Listen carefully before forming a judgment; offer your time to help another.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You as I face a moment of disappointment; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life reflects God's character in ordinary choices. Consider a task at work in the light of holiness in daily life. Encourage unity in the church; take responsibility for an error.
topics.prayer: Father, form a holy heart in me as I face a task at work; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God remains a refuge amid changing circumstances. Consider a reminder of eternity in the light of confidence in God's care. Keep a commitment you have made; examine your motives before responding.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your care as I face a reminder of eternity; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer is an act of humble dependence upon God. Consider an anxious thought in the light of faithful intercession. Offer your time to help another; offer encouragement without seeking praise.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with love as I face an anxious thought; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance means turning to Christ and away from sin. Consider a quiet time of reflection in the light of repentance and mercy. Serve a person who needs practical care; remember a promise of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a quiet time of reflection; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is demonstrated through obedient action. Consider an opportunity to encourage in the light of obedient faith. Choose humility when corrected; make time for prayer and reflection.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face an opportunity to encourage; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit strengthens believers to follow Christ. Consider a need to keep a promise in the light of the Spirit's help. Offer encouragement without seeking praise; resist a careless word.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen me by Your Spirit as I face a need to keep a promise; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel should be shared truthfully and compassionately. Consider a chance to serve in the light of witnessing with compassion. Pray for someone facing difficulty; listen carefully before forming a judgment.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful witness as I face a chance to serve; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian love is expressed through patience and service. Consider a need for patience in the light of unity and love. Finish the day with gratitude; complete a responsibility faithfully.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with patience and love as I face a need for patience; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Scripture calls us to practise what we learn. Consider a question requiring wisdom in the light of practising the Scriptures. Resist a careless word; share hope without pressuring others.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a question requiring wisdom; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom grows as we seek God and heed His Word. Consider an opportunity to listen in the light of seeking godly wisdom. Recall God's faithfulness; offer your time to help another.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face an opportunity to listen; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for Christ is lived through faithful discipleship. Consider an unexpected delay in the light of watchfulness and hope. Choose forgiveness over resentment; take responsibility for an error.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful and watchful as I face an unexpected delay; direct me in Christ's way.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Wisdom grows as we seek God and heed His Word. Consider a moment to seek forgiveness in the light of seeking godly wisdom. Ask God for help before acting; take a faithful step instead of delaying.
entries.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face a moment to seek forgiveness; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A renewed heart seeks the Lord in sincerity. Consider an invitation to witness in the light of renewed devotion. Ask what obedience requires today; take a faithful step instead of delaying.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You as I face an invitation to witness; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life reflects God's character in ordinary choices. Consider a concern for a neighbour in the light of holiness in daily life. Take a faithful step instead of delaying; choose forgiveness over resentment.
topics.prayer: Father, form a holy heart in me as I face a concern for a neighbour; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God remains a refuge amid changing circumstances. Consider uncertain plans in the light of confidence in God's care. Complete a responsibility faithfully; keep a commitment you have made.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your care as I face uncertain plans; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer is an act of humble dependence upon God. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of faithful intercession. Speak with kindness and honesty; show integrity in an unseen task.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with love as I face a temptation to complain; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance means turning to Christ and away from sin. Consider a neglected duty in the light of repentance and mercy. Show integrity in an unseen task; let your conduct agree with your confession.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a neglected duty; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.reflection: Trust in God is demonstrated through obedient action. Consider a responsibility at home in the light of obedient faith. Take responsibility for an error; choose humility when corrected.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face a responsibility at home; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit strengthens believers to follow Christ. Consider a time to show compassion in the light of the Spirit's help. Seek wise counsel before deciding; make peace where it is possible.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen me by Your Spirit as I face a time to show compassion; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful witness as I face a misunderstanding; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian love is expressed through patience and service. Consider a request for help in the light of unity and love. Remember a promise of Scripture; finish the day with gratitude.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with patience and love as I face a request for help; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a choice between convenience and integrity; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face a moment to seek forgiveness; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a neglected duty; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face a responsibility at home; direct me in Christ's way.

entries.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face a time to show compassion; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A renewed heart seeks the Lord in sincerity. Consider a concern for a neighbour in the light of renewed devotion. Keep a commitment you have made; ask what obedience requires today.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You as I face a concern for a neighbour; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life reflects God's character in ordinary choices. Consider uncertain plans in the light of holiness in daily life. Offer your time to help another; recall God's faithfulness.
topics.prayer: Father, form a holy heart in me as I face uncertain plans; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God remains a refuge amid changing circumstances. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of confidence in God's care. Serve a person who needs practical care; encourage unity in the church.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your care as I face a temptation to complain; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer is an act of humble dependence upon God. Consider a neglected duty in the light of faithful intercession. Choose humility when corrected; speak with kindness and honesty.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with love as I face a neglected duty; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance means turning to Christ and away from sin. Consider a responsibility at home in the light of repentance and mercy. Offer encouragement without seeking praise; practise patience with someone today.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a responsibility at home; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is demonstrated through obedient action. Consider a time to show compassion in the light of obedient faith. Pray for someone facing difficulty; serve a person who needs practical care.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face a time to show compassion; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit strengthens believers to follow Christ. Consider a misunderstanding in the light of the Spirit's help. Finish the day with gratitude; seek wise counsel before deciding.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen me by Your Spirit as I face a misunderstanding; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel should be shared truthfully and compassionately. Consider a request for help in the light of witnessing with compassion. Resist a careless word; give thanks for a small blessing.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful witness as I face a request for help; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian love is expressed through patience and service. Consider a choice between convenience and integrity in the light of unity and love. Recall God's faithfulness; pray for someone facing difficulty.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with patience and love as I face a choice between convenience and integrity; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Scripture calls us to practise what we learn. Consider a moment to seek forgiveness in the light of practising the Scriptures. Choose forgiveness over resentment; remember the needs of your community.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a moment to seek forgiveness; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom grows as we seek God and heed His Word. Consider a new responsibility in the light of seeking godly wisdom. Share hope without pressuring others; ask what obedience requires today.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face a new responsibility; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for Christ is lived through faithful discipleship. Consider a decision requiring courage in the light of watchfulness and hope. Practise patience with someone today; recall God's faithfulness.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful and watchful as I face a decision requiring courage; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face an unexpected delay; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is demonstrated through obedient action. Consider a moment of gratitude in the light of obedient faith. Offer encouragement without seeking praise; choose forgiveness over resentment.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face a moment of gratitude; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit strengthens believers to follow Christ. Consider an invitation to witness in the light of the Spirit's help. Pray for someone facing difficulty; keep a commitment you have made.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen me by Your Spirit as I face an invitation to witness; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel should be shared truthfully and compassionately. Consider a concern for a neighbour in the light of witnessing with compassion. Finish the day with gratitude; show integrity in an unseen task.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful witness as I face a concern for a neighbour; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian love is expressed through patience and service. Consider uncertain plans in the light of unity and love. Resist a careless word; let your conduct agree with your confession.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with patience and love as I face uncertain plans; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Scripture calls us to practise what we learn. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of practising the Scriptures. Recall God's faithfulness; choose humility when corrected.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a temptation to complain; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face a neglected duty; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

topics.reflection: A renewed heart seeks the Lord in sincerity. Consider a decision requiring courage in the light of renewed devotion. Seek wise counsel before deciding; finish the day with gratitude.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You as I face a decision requiring courage; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life reflects God's character in ordinary choices. Consider a conflict that needs peace in the light of holiness in daily life. Make peace where it is possible; ask God for help before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, form a holy heart in me as I face a conflict that needs peace; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God remains a refuge amid changing circumstances. Consider a call to persevere in the light of confidence in God's care. Remember a promise of Scripture; take a faithful step instead of delaying.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your care as I face a call to persevere; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer is an act of humble dependence upon God. Consider a difficult conversation in the light of faithful intercession. Remember the needs of your community; choose forgiveness over resentment.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with love as I face a difficult conversation; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance means turning to Christ and away from sin. Consider an opportunity to forgive in the light of repentance and mercy. Ask God for help before acting; keep a commitment you have made.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face an opportunity to forgive; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is demonstrated through obedient action. Consider a moment of disappointment in the light of obedient faith. Listen carefully before forming a judgment; show integrity in an unseen task.
topics.prayer: Father, increase my faith and obedience as I face a moment of disappointment; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit strengthens believers to follow Christ. Consider a task at work in the light of the Spirit's help. Encourage unity in the church; let your conduct agree with your confession.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen me by Your Spirit as I face a task at work; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel should be shared truthfully and compassionately. Consider a reminder of eternity in the light of witnessing with compassion. Keep a commitment you have made; choose humility when corrected.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful witness as I face a reminder of eternity; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian love is expressed through patience and service. Consider an anxious thought in the light of unity and love. Offer your time to help another; make peace where it is possible.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with patience and love as I face an anxious thought; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Scripture calls us to practise what we learn. Consider a quiet time of reflection in the light of practising the Scriptures. Serve a person who needs practical care; avoid a hasty decision.
topics.prayer: Father, help me obey Your Word as I face a quiet time of reflection; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wisdom grows as we seek God and heed His Word. Consider an opportunity to encourage in the light of seeking godly wisdom. Choose humility when corrected; finish the day with gratitude.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom and discernment as I face an opportunity to encourage; direct me in Christ's way.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for Christ is lived through faithful discipleship. Consider a need to keep a promise in the light of watchfulness and hope. Offer encouragement without seeking praise; ask God for help before acting.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me faithful and watchful as I face a need to keep a promise; direct me in Christ's way.
